main: ^The soldiers began discussing with the General, and you can only wait patiently and watch.
^You observe multiple makeshift jail cells, ducking your head as the cries and wales of hungry and mistreated Filipinos haunt you.
^The soldier brings the tag you obtained from Hideo to the General.
^General, that frail Filipino boy over by the entrance… He has a hold of this tag.
^What should we do with the kid, General?
^We can put him in jail like the rest of ‘em.
^The two soldiers share a hearty laugh.
^The General raises a hand to silence them.
^What you should do is interrogate him further. Find where Hideo was last seen and send soldiers there after to retrieve him, copy?
^Wow, aren’t you a good kid, sat still when ordered to.
^We are gonna ask you more questions, okay? Let’s start with this.
ruinedPlantation: ^Most probably. Did… Did Hideo give this to you?

c-0: ^Hey now, we can’t just rule him out. He’s probably there in need of help.
^Or, he forcefully took this tag from an already rotting Hideo.
^The soldier kneels down to your height and hangs the tag right in front of you.
^Right, that’s what you did, right? You killed Hideo, and Hideo is dead because of you?

iDontKnow: ^Woah, calm down. That’s just a kid!
^We’ve seen what those nasty Filipino rebellion fighters can do. Who knows, they might even be low enough to send a kid with a bomb strapped to his back to blow us all up?
^Well, either way, he looks terrified. Weak and terrified. I doubt he did something to Hideo in that sorry state.
^The soldiers continue arguing while you sit silently between them.
answeredQuestion: ^No matter. This Filipino could’ve killed Hideo or left him for dead. He’s no saint. He knew what he had to do to survive.
^He was hurt… in the plantation. I gave him water. I wrapped his shoulder.
^Hah! Listen to that. A Filipino helping one of us?
^Soldier 2 studies you carefully. Behind them, the General finally speaks.
^The tag belongs to Hideo of the 4th Division. We’ll send a patrol to the ruined plantation ASAP.
^Hold him here until we know the truth.
